result.title: ProCARE: Real-World Study Automation via Profile-Grounded Evidence Contracts
result.comment: 42 pages, 5 figures, including appendix. Accepted by NeurIPS'26. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/ZyFanTJ/ProCARE
result.summary: Real-world studies (RWS) analyze routinely collected healthcare data, such as electronic health records and insurance claims, to estimate treatment effects, monitor safety, and identify risk factors outside randomized trials. Automating RWS with large language model agents is appealing but brittle: valid analyses depend on dataset-specific clinical semantics, including index dates, follow-up windows, patient/event-level units, and outcome boundaries that are often implicit in observational data. This leads to schema mismatches, temporal errors, inconsistent analytical granularity, and unsupported clinical claims. We present ProCARE, a profile-grounded framework that reformulates RWS automation as constrained compilation. ProCARE converts heterogeneous data profiles into Evidence Contracts specifying available variables, temporal attributes, distributions, and evidentiary limits, and compiles study objectives into RWS-IR, a strongly typed intermediate representation for variables, time relations, analysis units, and statistical tasks. Deterministic validation and localized repair then check and revise generated workflows across schema mapping, cohort construction, variable derivation, analysis, and interpretation. On 36 EHR-based benchmark tasks, ProCARE outperforms strong LLM-agent baselines in code executability, semantic consistency, and conclusion traceability, with automated violation diagnoses showing moderate-to-substantial agreement with blinded expert review.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ProCARE，把 EHR/理赔等真实世界研究（RWS）的自动化重构为「受约束编译」：先将数据 profile 转成规定可用变量、时间属性与证据边界的 Evidence Contract，再把研究目标编译为强类型中间表示 RWS-IR，并用确定性校验与局部修复检查生成的流程；在 36 个 EHR 任务上优于 LLM agent 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「Evidence Contract + 强类型中间表示 + 确定性验证」显式约束了可用证据与证据边界，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、证据充分性判断与停止决策的表述方式提供概念线索，尚需阅读原文核查可否迁移。
